tools.name: packeta_validate_packet
tools.description: Check packet data against Packeta's rules without creating anything. Use it before packeta_create_packet. Packeta API: packetAttributesValid.

tools.name: packeta_packet_status
tools.description: Get the current status of a packet: its state, whether it is returning to the sender, the last day it can be picked up, and its carrier. Packeta API: packetStatus.

tools.name: packeta_packet_tracking
tools.description: Get the full tracking history of a packet, one record per status change. Packeta API: packetTracking.

tools.name: packeta_packet_info
tools.description: Get a packet's destination branch, verified invoice weight, and courier consignment details (courier, courier numbers, barcodes), when there is one. Packeta API: packetInfo.

tools.name: packeta_shipment_packets
tools.description: List the packets inside a shipment, given its D-code or B-code shipment ID. Packeta API: shipmentPackets.

tools.name: packeta_return_routing
tools.description: Get the two return routing strings of a sender, to print on return labels. They change with account settings, so fetch them each time. Packeta API: senderGetReturnRouting.

tools.name: packeta_create_packet
tools.description: Create a packet in the customer's Packeta account and return its ID and barcode. This is a live action: the packet is registered at once and can be handed to a carrier. Run packeta_validate_packet first. Packeta API: createPacket.

tools.name: packeta_cancel_packet
tools.description: Cancel a packet that has not been physically handed over yet. The cancellation cannot be undone. Packeta API: cancelPacket.
